description: Landscape sketch done in red pencil. In the foreground there are three long boulder like formations that dominate two-thirds of the page. A plant is visible on the right side of the paper, just above the top of the boulder like formations. A smaller plant is on the left side. In the distance, a line represents the horizon.
title: Untitled (Colorado Landscape)
